create.name: Iyengar Yoga Centrum Oosterhout en Breda
create.bio:
Known by its initials IYCOB, the Iyengar Yoga Centrum Oosterhout en Breda is a family-run Iyengar school in North Brabant, founded in 1989 by Pascal Poell and led today by him and his wife Irma Menssink. Both are certified at Level 3. Pascal has practised the method since 1984, has taught it since 1990, and has returned to the Ramamani Iyengar Memorial Yoga Institute in Pune more than twenty times since 1991; he also mentors and assesses teachers for the Dutch Iyengar association. Irma, who has taught yoga groups since 1998, also guides the centre's meditation evenings.

Classes run in two studios, one in the Oosterheide district of Oosterhout and one in the Haagpoort district of Breda, with weekly sessions of different lengths booked in three blocks a year, a longer Wednesday evening class in Breda and a pilot evening class in Tilburg. Practice covers posture work and pranayama, with meditation offered separately. Several times a year the couple teach Saturday or Sunday morning study sessions and themed workshops on the Level 1 to 3 postures. The centre formerly ran a teacher training for the province, which now takes the form of personal mentoring for students preparing to become certified Iyengar teachers.

courses.title: Weekly Iyengar yoga classes (blocks)
courses.description: Weekly classes of 75 minutes to three hours at the Oosterhout and Breda studios, paid by the block in three terms a year. Trial classes and single drop-in classes are priced on the same page.
courses.price: 1 ½ uur les per week – blok 1 € 188,50; blok 3 € 251,25

courses.title: Verdiepingslessen (Mentoring en verdiepingslessen)
courses.description: A three-hour weekend morning session with Pascal Poell and Irma Menssink for students who want to take their weekly practice further, with individual guidance in postures and pranayama based on the Level 1 to 3 syllabus. Mentored students also attend.

courses.title: B.K.S. Iyengar Yoga mentortraject
courses.description: Personal mentoring towards certification as an Iyengar teacher, which replaced the centre's earlier teacher-training course in line with the guidelines from the institute in Pune. Pascal Poell and Irma Menssink act as mentors.
